subject: afrikaans-fal
description: Afrikaans First Additional Language (CAPS Foundation Phase, Grades 1-3) consolidated question bank. TUTORING-FIRST model (not testing): every skill targets 20+ items; a learner works through the whole set; a wrong answer triggers Ruby reteaching (show the memo) and re-queues that item later (reteach_on_error + complete_when='all_items_correct_once'); nothing blocks and there is no pass/streak gate. Per-skill fields: gate (NONE), complete_when, reteach_on_error, target_item_count (20), caps_term, sensitive, templates, recovery_strategy, questions[]. SCHEMA per question: ref, question (English instruction shown on screen), ruby_prompt (friendly English voiceover), audio (Afrikaans text the engine speaks aloud — present on listening/phonics items), context (optional note), image_refs (optional array of image keys from afrikaans-image-manifest.md, for image-match), input_type (choice|true-false|image-match|sequence|text|cloze), options, expected, memo (English explanation/reteach shown after), error_signals, difficulty (1-3). FAL pedagogy: instructions/hints in English (home language), target content in Afrikaans.

questions.question: What does 'Sy kan nie spring nie' mean?

questions.memo: The two 'nie' words make it negative: 'She cannot jump.'

AF.G1.TAA.09.title: Byvoeglike naamwoorde en bywoorde (adjectives & adverbs)
AF.G1.TAA.09.description: Understand simple Afrikaans describing words (adjectives) and how-words (adverbs).

questions.question: What does 'gelukkig' mean?

questions.question: Which word means 'slow'?

questions.question: Finish: 'Die seun is ___.' (The boy is happy)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which describing word means 'happy'? Die seun is ___.
questions.memo: 'gelukkig' means 'happy': 'Die seun is gelukkig' (The boy is happy).

AF.G2.LUI.01.title: Volg opeenvolgende instruksies (follow consecutive instructions)
AF.G2.LUI.01.description: Respond to two short consecutive Afrikaans instructions.
AF.G2.LUI.01.recovery_strategy: Replay and break into one step at a time. Confirm the first step before the second.

questions.question: What two things were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both steps, then choose.
questions.audio: Trek 'n sirkel. Kleur dit rooi in.
options: Draw a circle, then colour it red
Draw a square, then colour it blue
Colour a circle, then draw a line
questions.expected: Draw a circle, then colour it red
questions.memo: 'Trek 'n sirkel' = draw a circle; 'Kleur dit rooi in' = colour it red.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both steps.
questions.audio: Vat die boek. Sit dit op die tafel.
options: Take the book, put it on the table
Take the pen, put it in the bag
Open the book on the table
questions.expected: Take the book, put it on the table
questions.memo: 'Vat die boek' = take the book; 'Sit dit op die tafel' = put it on the table.

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what to do first.
questions.audio: Was jou hande. Eet jou kos.
questions.memo: 'Was jou hande' (wash your hands) is said first, then 'Eet jou kos' (eat your food).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both steps.
questions.audio: Staan op. Loop na die deur.
options: Stand up, walk to the door
Sit down, look at the door
questions.expected: Stand up, walk to the door
questions.memo: 'Staan op' = stand up; 'Loop na die deur' = walk to the door.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both steps.
questions.audio: Maak die boek oop. Lees die storie.
options: Open the book, read the story
Close the book, draw a picture
Open the door, read the sign
questions.expected: Open the book, read the story
questions.memo: 'Maak die boek oop' = open the book; 'Lees die storie' = read the story.

AF.G2.LUI.02.title: Identifiseer voorwerp uit beskrywing (identify object from description)
AF.G2.LUI.02.description: Listen to a simple Afrikaans description and choose the object it describes.
AF.G2.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: Re-read the description one clue at a time and rule options out clue by clue.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rond en rooi. Jy speel daarmee.
questions.memo: Round, red and you play with it = 'n bal (a ball).

questions.question: What animal is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vier bene. Dit blaf. Dit is 'n troeteldier.
questions.memo: Four legs, it barks (blaf), a pet = 'n hond (a dog).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is geel. Jy eet dit. 'n Aap hou daarvan.
questions.memo: Yellow, you eat it, a monkey likes it = 'n piesang (a banana).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit skyn in die dag. Dit is warm en geel.
questions.memo: Shines in the day, warm and yellow = die son (the sun).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy trek dit aan jou voete. Jy stap daarmee.
questions.memo: You put them on your feet and walk = skoene (shoes).

AF.G2.LUI.03.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n storie — gebeure in volgorde (story comprehension: events in order)
AF.G2.LUI.03.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans story and answer comprehension and ordering questions.
AF.G2.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Re-read and pause after each event. Ask 'what happened next?' before the ordering question.

questions.question: What did Tom do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: The story says 'Tom het opgestaan' first — he got up first.

questions.question: What did Tom do LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen again, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: 'Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan' is the last event — he went to school last.

questions.question: Why was the girl happy?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Lisa het 'n present gekry. Sy was baie bly.
questions.memo: 'Lisa het 'n present gekry' — she got a present, so she was happy (bly).

questions.question: Where did the family go?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die gesin het strand toe gegaan. Hulle het in die see geswem.
questions.memo: 'strand toe gegaan' = went to the beach; they swam in the sea.

questions.question: What did the dog do after it ate?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die hond het kos geëet. Toe het hy gaan slaap.
questions.memo: 'Toe het hy gaan slaap' — after eating, the dog went to sleep.

AF.G2.KLK.01.title: Onderskei verwarrende klanke (distinguish confusable sounds)
AF.G2.KLK.01.description: Tell apart Afrikaans sounds that are easily confused.
AF.G2.KLK.01.recovery_strategy: Say the two words back to back, exaggerating the differing vowel. Show the letters.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'mier' (ant) has the 'ie' sound; 'muur' (wall) has the 'uu' sound.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'bal' (ball) has the 'a' sound; 'bel' (bell) has the 'e' sound.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'pen' has the 'e' sound; 'pan' has the 'a' sound.

questions.question: Do 'kat' and 'kot' have the same middle sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both. Same middle sound?
questions.memo: 'kat' has 'a' in the middle; 'kot' has 'o'. Different sounds.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'vis' (fish) has the 'i' sound; 'vas' (firm) has the 'a' sound.

AF.G2.KLK.02.title: Letter-klank verhoudings (letter-sound relationships)
AF.G2.KLK.02.description: Match single Afrikaans letters to their sounds.
AF.G2.KLK.02.recovery_strategy: Show the letter, say its sound, give a key word (m -> /m/ -> mat).

questions.question: Which letter makes the /m/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /m/. Which letter is it?
questions.memo: The letter 'm' makes the /m/ sound, like in 'mat'.

questions.question: Which letter makes the /s/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /s/. Which letter is it?
questions.memo: The letter 's' makes the /s/ sound, like in 'son'.

questions.question: What sound does the letter 'v' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: In Afrikaans, what sound does 'v' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans the letter 'v' makes an /f/ sound, like in 'vis' (fish).

questions.question: Which letter makes the /k/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /k/. Which letter is it?
questions.memo: The letter 'k' makes the /k/ sound, like in 'kat'.

questions.question: Which word starts with the letter that makes /h/?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word starts with the /h/ letter?
questions.memo: 'hond' starts with 'h', which makes the /h/ sound.

AF.G2.KLK.03.title: Bou en breek 3-letterwoorde (build & break 3-letter words)
AF.G2.KLK.03.description: Blend and segment simple CVC Afrikaans words.
AF.G2.KLK.03.recovery_strategy: Sound each letter with a finger tap, then sweep to blend. For segmenting, stretch the word.

questions.question: Put the sounds together: k-a-t
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: k ... a ... t. What word?

questions.question: Put the sounds together: p-e-n
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: p ... e ... n. What word?

questions.question: Put the sounds together: b-u-s
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: b ... u ... s. What word?

questions.question: What is the first sound in 'mat'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Break it up: m-a-t. What is the first sound?

AF.G2.KLK.04.title: Woordfamilies (word families)
AF.G2.KLK.04.description: Group Afrikaans words that share a rime into families.
AF.G2.KLK.04.recovery_strategy: Fix the ending and swap the first letter. Read the family as a list.

questions.question: Which word is in the same family as 'kos' and 'los'?
questions.ruby_prompt: kos, los, ... which word fits?
questions.memo: kos, los, pos all end in -os — same word family.

questions.question: Which word is in the same family as 'kat' and 'mat'?
questions.ruby_prompt: kat, mat, ... which word fits?
questions.memo: kat, mat, lat all end in -at — same family.

questions.question: Which word does NOT belong: pen, hen, kos?
questions.ruby_prompt: Two are in the same family. Which one does not fit?
questions.memo: pen and hen end in -en; 'kos' ends in -os, so it does not belong.

questions.question: Which word is in the same family as 'bal' and 'sal'?
questions.ruby_prompt: bal, sal, ... which word fits?
questions.memo: bal, sal, mal all end in -al — same family.

questions.question: Which two words are in the same family: 'son', 'bon', 'kat'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word is in the same family as 'son'?
questions.memo: son and bon end in -on — same family.

AF.G2.KLK.05.title: Herken eindklanke (recognise end sounds)
AF.G2.KLK.05.description: Notice common Afrikaans end sounds (plurals, diminutives).
AF.G2.KLK.05.recovery_strategy: Say base word then changed word, stressing the added ending.

questions.question: What is the little (diminutive) form of 'kat'?

questions.question: Which ending shows MORE THAN ONE in 'appels'?

questions.question: What is the little (diminutive) form of 'boom'?

AF.G2.TAA.05.description: Understand and use the Afrikaans linking verb 'is'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Sy ___ gelukkig.' (She is happy)

questions.memo: 'Die kat is klein' = 'The cat is small'. 'is' goes after the subject.

questions.question: What does 'Die kos is lekker' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Die kos is lekker'. What does it mean?

questions.question: A poster says 'MOENIE ROMMEL STROOI NIE'. What does it ask?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'MOENIE ROMMEL STROOI NIE'. What does it ask?
questions.memo: 'Moenie rommel strooi nie' = Do not litter (rommel = litter).

questions.question: A shop sign says 'OOP'. What does it mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the shop sign: 'OOP'. What does it mean?

questions.question: A heading reads 'DIE WEER VANDAG'. What is it about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the heading: 'DIE WEER VANDAG'. What is it about?

questions.question: A sign says 'STADIG'. What does it tell drivers?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the road sign: 'STADIG'. What does it mean?

AF.G3.LEE.02.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae — uitgebrei (comprehension incl. why)
AF.G3.LEE.02.description: Read a short Afrikaans text and answer comprehension questions, including why.
AF.G3.LEE.02.recovery_strategy: Re-read the sentence that gives the reason. Underline cause-and-effect words.

questions.question: Read: 'Thabo huil, want hy het sy bal verloor.' Why is Thabo crying?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then answer why.
questions.context: Text: 'Thabo huil, want hy het sy bal verloor.'
questions.memo: 'want hy het sy bal verloor' = because he lost his ball.

questions.question: Read: 'Die plante groei, want dit reën baie.' Why do the plants grow?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then answer why.
questions.context: Text: 'Die plante groei, want dit reën baie.'
questions.memo: 'want dit reën baie' = because it rains a lot.

questions.question: Read: 'Ouma bak koek vir Sara se verjaarsdag.' Who is the cake for?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then answer.
questions.context: Text: 'Ouma bak koek vir Sara se verjaarsdag.'
questions.memo: 'vir Sara se verjaarsdag' = for Sara's birthday.

questions.question: Read: 'Die kinders dra truie, want dit is koud.' Why do they wear jerseys?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then answer why.
questions.context: Text: 'Die kinders dra truie, want dit is koud.'
questions.memo: 'want dit is koud' = because it is cold.

questions.question: Read: 'Die voël kan nie vlieg nie, want sy vlerk is seer.' Why can't the bird fly?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then answer why.
questions.context: Text: 'Die voël kan nie vlieg nie, want sy vlerk is seer.'
questions.memo: 'want sy vlerk is seer' = because its wing is sore.

AF.G3.LEE.03.title: Rangskik gebeure in volgorde (order events)
AF.G3.LEE.03.description: Read a short Afrikaans story and order its events.
AF.G3.LEE.03.recovery_strategy: Find the first event, then ask 'what happened next?' for each step.

questions.question: Put the story in order.
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the steps, then order them.
questions.context: Steps: A) Sy eet die koek. B) Sy bak die koek. C) Sy meng die deeg.
questions.memo: Mix the dough, bake the cake, then eat it.

questions.question: Which happens FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the steps. Which happens first?
questions.context: Steps: Hy ry skool toe. Hy klim op die bus. Hy wag by die bushalte.
questions.memo: Wait at the bus stop, climb on the bus, then ride to school.

questions.question: Put the story in order.
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the steps, then order them.
questions.context: Steps: A) Die saad word 'n plant. B) Sy plant die saad. C) Sy gee water.
questions.memo: Plant the seed, water it, then it becomes a plant.

questions.question: Which happens LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the steps. Which happens last?
questions.context: Steps: Hy droog homself af. Hy klim in die bad. Hy was homself.
questions.memo: Climb into the bath, wash, then dry yourself (droog af) last.

questions.question: Put the story in order.
questions.ruby_prompt: Read the steps, then order them.
questions.context: Steps: A) Hulle eet die kos. B) Pappa maak vuur. C) Hulle braai die vleis.
questions.memo: Make the fire, braai the meat, then eat the food.

AF.G3.LEE.04.title: Som 'n niefiksie-teks op (summarise non-fiction)
AF.G3.LEE.04.description: Read short Afrikaans non-fiction and choose the best summary.
AF.G3.LEE.04.recovery_strategy: Ask 'what is the whole text mostly about?' Rule out details too small to be the summary.

questions.question: Read the text. What is the best summary?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Spinnekoppe het agt bene. Hulle spin webbe. Hulle vang insekte in hul webbe.'
questions.memo: Every sentence is a fact about spinnekoppe (spiders).

questions.question: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it again, then answer.
questions.context: Text: 'Spinnekoppe het agt bene. Hulle spin webbe. Hulle vang insekte in hul webbe.'

questions.question: Read the text. What is the best summary?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Reën val uit die wolke. Dit vul die damme. Mense en plante het water nodig.'
questions.memo: The text is about rain and why water is needed — why rain is important.

questions.question: Read the text. What is the best summary?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Bye maak heuning. Hulle woon in 'n byekorf. Hulle help blomme groei.'
questions.memo: Every sentence is a fact about bye (bees).

questions.question: What do bees make?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it again, then answer.
questions.context: Text: 'Bye maak heuning. Hulle woon in 'n byekorf. Hulle help blomme groei.'

AF.G3.LEE.05.title: Gebruik diagramme en illustrasies (use diagrams & illustrations)
AF.G3.LEE.05.description: Use an Afrikaans labelled diagram/illustration to answer questions.
AF.G3.LEE.05.recovery_strategy: Point to the labelled part of the diagram that answers the question.

questions.question: On a labelled plant diagram, where are the 'blare' (leaves)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Look at the diagram. Where are the 'blare'?
questions.memo: 'blare' means 'leaves' — the green parts at the top.

questions.question: On the plant diagram, what is the 'wortel'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Look at the diagram. What is the 'wortel'?

questions.question: A diagram labels a body. Where is the 'kop'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Look at the diagram. Where is the 'kop'?
questions.memo: 'kop' means 'head' — at the top of the body.

questions.question: On the body diagram, what is the 'arm'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Look at the diagram. What is the 'arm'?

questions.question: A weather chart shows a sun for 'Maandag'. What is the weather on Monday?
questions.ruby_prompt: Look at the chart. What is the weather on 'Maandag'?
questions.memo: The sun symbol on 'Maandag' (Monday) means it is sunny (sonnig).

AF.G3.TAA.01.title: Toekomende tyd (future tense: sal)
AF.G3.TAA.01.description: Understand and form the Afrikaans future tense with 'sal'.
AF.G3.TAA.01.recovery_strategy: Tie 'sal' to something not yet done (later/môre). Contrast with the past 'het'.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the FUTURE (will happen)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one will happen later?
questions.memo: 'Ek sal speel' = 'I will play' (future). 'sal' shows it has not happened yet.

questions.question: How do you say 'She will come'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which sentence means 'She will come'?

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek ___ môre swem.' (I will swim tomorrow)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes it future? Ek ___ môre swem.
questions.memo: 'sal' makes the future: 'Ek sal môre swem' = 'I will swim tomorrow'.

questions.question: What does 'Ons sal eet' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ons sal eet'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Hulle ___ later kom.' (They will come later)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes it future? Hulle ___ later kom.
questions.memo: 'Hulle sal later kom' = 'They will come later'.

AF.G3.TAA.02.title: Al drie tye (present, past, future contrasted)
AF.G3.TAA.02.description: Tell apart and choose the right Afrikaans tense.
AF.G3.TAA.02.recovery_strategy: Anchor each tense to a time word: nou (present), gister (past), môre (future).

questions.question: Which sentence is in the PAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one already happened?
questions.memo: 'Ek het geëet' = 'I ate' (past). 'het ge-' shows the past.

questions.question: Which time word goes with 'Ek het gespeel'?
questions.ruby_prompt: 'Ek het gespeel' is past. Which time word fits?

questions.question: Finish for tomorrow: 'Ek ___ môre gaan.'
questions.ruby_prompt: 'môre' = tomorrow. Which word fits? Ek ___ môre gaan.
questions.memo: 'môre' needs the future: 'Ek sal môre gaan' = 'I will go tomorrow'.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the PRESENT (happening now)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one is happening now?

questions.question: Which time word goes with 'Ons sal swem'?
questions.ruby_prompt: 'Ons sal swem' is future. Which time word fits?

AF.G3.TAA.03.title: Lidwoorde ('n, die)
AF.G3.TAA.03.description: Use the Afrikaans articles ''n' and 'die' correctly.
AF.G3.TAA.03.recovery_strategy: Use ''n' for any one (a dog) and 'die' for a specific one (the dog we know).

questions.question: What does ''n appel' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: ''n appel'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'die appel' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'die appel'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek sien ___ hond.' (a dog — any dog)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article means 'a'? Ek sien ___ hond.
questions.memo: ''n' means 'a': 'Ek sien 'n hond' = 'I see a dog'.

questions.question: Finish: '___ son skyn.' (The sun — there is only one)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article means 'the'? ___ son skyn.
questions.memo: There is only one sun, so use 'die': 'Die son skyn' = 'The sun shines'.

questions.question: Which means 'a book' (any book)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one means 'a book'?

AF.G3.TAA.04.title: Trappe van vergelyking (degrees of comparison)
AF.G3.TAA.04.description: Understand and use Afrikaans degrees of comparison.
AF.G3.TAA.04.recovery_strategy: Line up three things small-to-big: groot, groter, grootste. Stress -er and -ste.

questions.question: Finish: groot, groter, ___
questions.ruby_prompt: What comes next? groot, groter, ___

questions.question: Which word means 'faster'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'faster'?

questions.question: Finish: 'Die olifant is ___ as die hond.' (bigger)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'bigger'? Die olifant is ___ as die hond.
questions.memo: Comparing two things uses -er: 'groter as' = 'bigger than'.

questions.question: Which word means 'the smallest'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'smallest'?

questions.question: Finish: lank, langer, ___
questions.ruby_prompt: What comes next? lank, langer, ___

AF.G3.TAA.05.title: Aanwysende voornaamwoorde (demonstratives)
AF.G3.TAA.05.description: Understand and use Afrikaans demonstratives: hierdie, daardie, dit.
AF.G3.TAA.05.recovery_strategy: Point near (hierdie) and far (daardie) with real objects. Practise the pair together.

questions.question: What does 'hierdie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: What does 'hierdie' mean?

questions.question: What does 'daardie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: What does 'daardie' mean?

questions.question: Finish: '___ boek hier is myne.' (This book here)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'this' (near)? ___ boek hier is myne.

questions.question: Finish: '___ hond daar is groot.' (That dog there)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'that' (far)? ___ hond daar is groot.

questions.question: What does 'dit' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: What does 'dit' mean?

AF.G3.TAA.06.title: Vraagsinne (Watter? Waarom?)
AF.G3.TAA.06.description: Understand and use a variety of Afrikaans question words.
AF.G3.TAA.06.recovery_strategy: Tie 'Watter?' to a choice between options and 'Waarom?' to a reason (omdat ...).

questions.question: What does 'Waarom?' ask for?
questions.ruby_prompt: The question word 'Waarom?' — what does it ask for?
questions.memo: 'Waarom?' means 'Why?' — it asks for a reason (answered with 'omdat ...').

questions.question: What does 'Watter?' ask for?
questions.ruby_prompt: The question word 'Watter?' — what does it ask for?
questions.memo: 'Watter?' means 'Which?' — it asks you to choose between options.

questions.question: Which question fits the answer 'Omdat dit gereën het' (Because it rained)?
questions.ruby_prompt: The answer gives a reason. Which question fits?

questions.question: Which question word means 'Why?'
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'Why?'

questions.question: Which question asks you to choose a colour?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which question asks you to pick which colour?
questions.memo: 'Watter kleur?' = 'Which colour?' — it asks you to choose.

AF.G3.TAA.07.title: Selfstandige naamwoorde en meervoude (nouns & plurals consolidated)
AF.G3.TAA.07.description: Recognise Afrikaans nouns (incl. uncountable) and consolidate plurals.
AF.G3.TAA.07.recovery_strategy: Sort words into 'can count' and 'cannot count' (suiker, sand). Review plural endings.

questions.question: Which can you count: 'appels' or 'suiker'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one can you count?
questions.memo: You can count apples (een appel, twee appels), but not sugar (suiker).

questions.question: What is the plural of 'kind'?
questions.ruby_prompt: More than one 'kind' (child) is...?

questions.question: Which word is a thing you cannot count?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one is something you cannot count one-by-one?
questions.memo: 'sand' is uncountable — you do not say 'two sands'.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'boom'?
questions.ruby_prompt: More than one 'boom' (tree) is...?

questions.question: Finish: 'Daar is baie ___ in die bos.' (trees)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'boom'? Daar is baie ___ in die bos.
questions.memo: 'bome' = trees: 'Daar is baie bome in die bos' = 'There are many trees in the forest'.
